explication: RuView is a WiFi sensing platform: edge sensors capture CSI, processing turns radio measurements into presence, pose, activity, and vital-sign estimates, and user-facing tools expose results for monitoring and automation. The graph also preserves documented capabilities for model/RVF workflows, privacy-governed evidence, smart-home bridges, and the operator harness. Some subsystem links come from README descriptions because their implementation files were not sampled; those relationships are cited to the README.
